messages:
maria-ops: quick follow-up from the PM postmortem (PM-2026). we need a small sweep across the runbook + playbook so oncall can triage faster. collating action items here. link: https://redwood.internal/postmortem/PM-2026 :spiral_notepad:
jon-smith: I can own triage steps + short checklist. planning to PR runbook edits today. will add explicit 'isolate kv-cache' step.
ryan-sre: thx jon. I'll take escalation path updates — clarify when to page infra vs eng-runtime, and add paging matrix.
alex-ml: I'll add the model/serving-specific commands and common suffixes. also include quick heuristics for cache vs model regression.
sarah-product: can we get customer-facing timeline bullet (who reaches out when)? i'll draft language after runbook edits.
jon-smith: draft triage checklist (short):
1) check cluster health: `kubectl get pods -n inference`
2) check tail logs: `kubectl logs -l app=inference -n inference --tail=200`
3) check runtime metrics: `curl -s http://metrics-redwood/internal/serve_health`
4) inspect KV cache hit rate: `redwoodctl cache inspect --model <model> --window 5m`
5) if cache eviction >40% -> run `redwoodctl cache pause --route <route>` and escalate to eng-runtime

maria-ops: jon please add exact commands for grabbing tenant ID + request traces, we had missing context in the incident.
jon-smith: added example: `redwoodctl traces query --tenant 12345 --since 30m` and `redwoodctl requests tail --route /v1/generate --limit 50`
alex-ml: adding model fallback guidance: if CPU-backed fallbacks are used, include `--kv-preserve` flag in rolling fallback to avoid warm-start regressions. snippet I'll paste in PR.
ryan-sre: escalation ladder (summary):
- page eng-runtime on severity >= P2 or sustained errors >5% for 10m
- page infra when node OOMs or GPU failures detected
- page platform-owner for cross-region impact
I'll add phone numbers and rotation references in the playbook.
incident-bot: Reminder: please add linked ticket IDs and mark action owners in the postmortem doc. (auto-reminder set for 3 days)
maria-ops: action items so far: 
- jon-smith: PR triage checklist + trace commands (due: 2d)
- ryan-sre: update escalation ladder + paging matrix (due: 3d)
- alex-ml: model-specific runbook snippets + fallback flags (due: 3d)
- sarah-product: customer messaging draft (due: 4d)
Please put tickets in the follow-up board (ST-9876). If anyone needs to shift dates, ping here.
jon-smith: starting PR now, will link to https://git.redwood/runbooks/inference-playbook (expect small changes)
alex-ml: also flagging recurring pattern: cache eviction spike tends to follow large batch uploads from ingestion-service. we should add a mitigator (ingestion-side rate limit) to playbook.
ryan-sre: noted. I'll add a 'suspected upstream spike' quick test and suggested temporary throttle command: `kubectl scale --replicas=0 deploy/ingestion-service -n ingestion` (temporary stop) + recommend safe rollback steps.
sarah-product: ok team — once PRs merged i'll schedule a 30-min runbook walkthrough with oncall next week. assigning meeting owner: maria-ops.
maria-ops: thanks. final ask: when you open PRs include a 1-line summary and a test step (how to validate). keeps oncall happy :slightly_smiling_face:
jon-smith: will do. marking this thread done after PRs are linked.
